_doc: Sand Creek Raceway through the Lake Murray chain (tools/ship_track.sh; Kevin 2026-10-28: 'rebuild all four with the Lake Murray chain'). The draft is the engine's own on the real OSM street centrelines (source.type osm since 0.33.0, ledger 0073: gps (route.roads 'id:' legs + route.fillet) -> elev -> project -> widths (osm_road_widths) -> grid -> mesh), then the underlay drops data/track.obj into loop.blend as GEN_* collections (scripts/blender/underlay.py). Authoring happens in that blend (AUTH_*), the prep / exporter run from airoso's scripts/ac, the four gates run on the BUILT kn5. The workshop lives OUTSIDE airoso.
_owed: The reverse layout is parked in track.config.json _layouts_v3_owed until its start is declared on the V3 centreline (layouts[].start -> tools/layout_dummies.py -> a spawn kn5; then steps.author gains layout_dummies and steps.ship gains spawn_kn5). Ledger 0070 D (2026-11-03, Kevin: "same lamps as lake murray, race curbs, no sidewalks, authored pad junctions"): the lamps are wired (lamps_plan after mesh: tools/plan_streetlights.py writes data/lights.local.json from the draft; lamps after the underlay: tools/author_lamps_blend.py stands led_cobra on it; track_folder checks the [LIGHT_N] per lens). NOT wired, and why (ledger 0070 "Dressing, 2026-11-03"): the junction pads (tools/author_junction_pad_blend.py needs the v021 scene, ROAD / CURB / TERRAIN and connector pieces; an engine draft has GEN_* 1ROAD_shoulder / 1ROAD_main / 1GRASS_* and the lap itself as both arms) and the race kerbs (race_furniture brings both K-rail curb strips the whole lap and a closure kn5 per race layout: three decisions for Kevin). No signs yet. The Colorado rebuild session's NAIP width (10.5 m on the straights, 2026-10-28) is on the Mac, not committed: carry it into width_overrides before the draft runs (kept from the first pass).
